name: Ranger
description: A swift hunter skilled with bow and blade. Rangers strike from afar and move with deadly precision.

skills.name: Aimed Shot
skills.description: Take careful aim for a devastating ranged attack at 180% damage.

skills.name: Double Strike
skills.description: Strike twice in rapid succession, each hit dealing 70% damage.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.description: Enter a defensive stance with 50% dodge chance for 2 turns.

skills.name: Poison Arrow
skills.description: Fire a poisoned arrow dealing damage plus poison for 3 turns.

skills.name: Volley
skills.description: Rain arrows on all enemies for 90% damage each.
